states.name: Colorado
states.intro: If you sell real estate in Colorado, a written buyer agreement isn't optional. Before you show a buyer a home, Colorado license law and the 2024 nationwide rules require a signed brokerage agreement that defines your relationship and your compensation. Threshold puts Colorado's Exclusive Right-to-Buy Brokerage Contract on your phone so you can complete and sign it in the field — at the coffee shop, in the car, or on the doorstep.
states.changed: Colorado has long required a defined, written brokerage relationship before an agent represents a buyer. Since August 17, 2024, agents who work through an MLS also must have a signed buyer agreement in place before touring a home — in person or virtually. That makes getting the Exclusive Right-to-Buy contract signed early a routine part of every Colorado buyer relationship.

faqs.q: Do Colorado real estate agents need a written buyer agreement?
faqs.a: Yes. Colorado requires a defined, written brokerage relationship for buyer representation, and since August 17, 2024 agents working through an MLS must have a signed buyer agreement before touring a home. Threshold makes it quick to complete and sign that agreement on the spot.

faqs.q: Which Colorado buyer agreement form does Threshold use?
faqs.a: Threshold is built around the Colorado Real Estate Commission's Exclusive Right-to-Buy Brokerage Contract — the standard buyer agency form Colorado brokerages use. Fields are guided so nothing required is left blank.

faqs.q: Can I sign a buyer agreement on my phone in Colorado?
faqs.a: Yes. You and your buyer can complete every required field and capture signatures on-screen, then export a PDF to send to your brokerage or client. No printer or scanner needed.

faqs.q: Does the agreement have to state my compensation?
faqs.a: Yes. The written buyer agreement must state a specific, objective compensation amount agreed with your buyer — it can't be open-ended. Threshold has a dedicated compensation step so the figure is captured clearly every time.
